title: Analysis of the Impact of Sustained Load and Temperature on the Performance of the Electromechanical Impedance Technique through Multilevel Machine Learning and FBG Sensors.
summary: Machine-learning models used electromechanical-impedance measurements, with fiber Bragg grating sensors recording load and temperature, to quantify how sustained mechanical load and temperature altered sensor impedance. This was an instrument/materials experiment under the reported conditions.
